en-SG.Sound volumes, graphics quality, frame r: Sound volumes, graphics quality, frame rate, controls, language, text size, high contrast and reduced motion are in the StarHermit Options (F1).
en-SG.Dawn watch, Captain. Three hostile hulls: Dawn watch, Captain. Three hostile hulls hide in a six-by-six sounding — small water, small fleet, no excuses. Find them and put them under.
en-SG.The gunnery crews are green, so the flee: The gunnery crews are green, so the fleet kindly anchored more targets in the sound. Same drill as yesterday — steadier hands this time.
en-SG.A fourth ship has joined the enemy floti: A fourth ship has joined the enemy flotilla — a cruiser, longer and harder to miss once you clip her. Work the grid methodically, Captain.
en-SG.The admiral has authorised pencil correc: The admiral has authorised pencil corrections on this exercise: take back a placement or a shot while you still learn the chart. Training wheels, nothing more.
en-SG.Mastery board, Captain: the same cramped: Mastery board, Captain: the same cramped water, but the opposing commander finally woke up. Clear the channel cleanly and the fleet sails at your word.
en-SG.The training pool is behind you. Eight b: The training pool is behind you. Eight by eight of open sea and a full five-ship squadron — carrier and all — waiting beyond the mist.
en-SG.New doctrine from the quartermaster: eve: New doctrine from the quartermaster: every shell is counted. You have a generous allowance for this patrol — spend it, but learn to spend it well.
en-SG.The magazines run thinner today. Fifty r: The magazines run thinner today. Fifty rounds for the whole engagement — a careful captain will not need the last ten.
en-SG.Forty-five shells and an enemy who has s: Forty-five shells and an enemy who has started reading your patterns. Hunt in straight lines, close on your hits, and the margin holds.
en-SG.Mastery board. The audit is simple, Capt: Mastery board. The audit is simple, Captain: sink the squadron inside forty-two rounds, or explain the shortfall to the fleet in person.
en-SG.Charts show a single loose mine adrift i: Charts show a single loose mine adrift in the patrol box. Striking it costs you an extra round and gains nothing — shoot around it, Captain.
en-SG.Two mines now, sown where the water runs: Two mines now, sown where the water runs shallow. The enemy hides among them and trusts you to be careless. Prove the trust misplaced.
en-SG.Now the two lessons meet: mines under th: Now the two lessons meet: mines under the water, a ledger over your head. Fifty rounds, two hazards, one squadron to erase.
en-SG.Three mines and forty-eight shells. Ever: Three mines and forty-eight shells. Every stray shot is a double loss now — the round, and the allowance it came from.
en-SG.Mastery board. The channel is sown thick: Mastery board. The channel is sown thick and the magazine is thin. Bring the fleet through, Captain, and no mine will ever frighten you again.
en-SG.Salvo doctrine, Captain: every ship stil: Salvo doctrine, Captain: every ship still afloat fires each turn. Your broadsides grow weaker as hulls die — so will theirs. Trade well.
en-SG.Two squadrons in line ahead, guns speaki: Two squadrons in line ahead, guns speaking in volleys. Kill their small ships early and starve their salvo before yours thins.
en-SG.Salvos feel generous until the ledger ar: Salvos feel generous until the ledger arrives. Forty-eight total shots across every volley — make the early ones count.
en-SG.Full broadsides over mined water. A salv: Full broadsides over mined water. A salvo that finds a mine pays double — watch where the volley falls.
en-SG.Mastery board. Salvos, mines, and a fort: Mastery board. Salvos, mines, and a forty-four shot ceiling, all at once. Conduct it cleanly, Captain, and the watch will remember.
en-SG.New standing order: no two ships may moo: New standing order: no two ships may moor hull-to-hull, not even corner to corner — collisions kill more fleets than guns do. Plot a spread formation.
en-SG.The enemy has jammed our signal lamps: s: The enemy has jammed our signal lamps: sinkings are confirmed, but no longer named. Count hulls in your head, Captain, because the chart will not.
en-SG.Ten by ten now — real ocean. The enemy f: Ten by ten now — real ocean. The enemy fields a vanguard squadron: a carrier, twin cruisers, escorts. More water to search, more steel to sink.
en-SG.Wide-berth discipline under signal fog,: Wide-berth discipline under signal fog, on the big water. You will not know what you have sunk — only that something stopped answering.
en-SG.Mastery board. A convoy you cannot name,: Mastery board. A convoy you cannot name, a sixty-shell allowance you cannot stretch. Trust the hunt, Captain — the ghosts will not trust you.
en-SG.Mines below, silence above. Two hazards: Mines below, silence above. Two hazards you must feel for and a foe whose losses you must tally yourself.
en-SG.Salvo discipline with parade-ground spac: Salvo discipline with parade-ground spacing — your ships may not touch, and every survivor fires. Elegant on paper, murder on water.
Big ocean, two mines, fifty-five rounds. The ledger looks generous until the tenth empty volley — guard it, Captain.
en-SG.Full broadsides under signal fog. Your g: Full broadsides under signal fog. Your guns speak in volleys; the enemy answers in silence. Count the quiet ones as they fall.
en-SG.Mastery board. Twin cruisers, three mine: Mastery board. Twin cruisers, three mines, fifty-eight rounds of cold arithmetic. The reckoning is yours to deliver, Captain.
en-SG.The requisition office has gone feral: f: The requisition office has gone feral: forty shots for a full squadron under salvo doctrine, against a commander who shoots back like a veteran.
en-SG.Three mines, no names for the dead, fort: Three mines, no names for the dead, forty-two rounds. The arithmetic is unforgiving and so is the water. Solve it anyway.
en-SG.Ten by ten and still not enough sea: str: Ten by ten and still not enough sea: strict spacing, three mines, fifty-two shells. Every mark on this chart must earn its ink.
en-SG.A vanguard squadron under full fog and s: A vanguard squadron under full fog and salvo fire, fifty-five rounds to finish it. They will not announce their dead. Neither will you.
en-SG.Mastery board. Salvos over mined water a: Mastery board. Salvos over mined water against the fleet’s best opposing mind. The protocol is iron, Captain — be iron with it.
en-SG.The gauntlet begins. Thirty-eight rounds: The gauntlet begins. Thirty-eight rounds, two mines, silent sinkings, and a full squadron that knows your trade. No margin was ever promised.
en-SG.Wide spacing, salvo fire, fifty shots on: Wide spacing, salvo fire, fifty shots on the big ocean. Discipline is the only supply ship still sailing with you, Captain.
en-SG.Twin cruisers, three mines, fifty-two ro: Twin cruisers, three mines, fifty-two rounds of thunder. Strike the hammer blow and do not waste the echo.
en-SG.Four mines and total silence. The toll i: Four mines and total silence. The toll is paid in shells and certainty, and you are short of both. One stage remains after this.
en-SG.The capstone, Captain: a vanguard squadr: The capstone, Captain: a vanguard squadron under fog and mines, salvo against salvo, fifty-five rounds in the locker. Win, and the fleet speaks your name in every port.
en-SG.The convoy sails at dusk and the magazin: The convoy sails at dusk and the magazine is nearly bare. Sink the squadron on the tightest allowance the quartermaster has ever signed.
en-SG.Salvo doctrine without restraint: every: Salvo doctrine without restraint: every hull afloat fires every turn, theirs included. End the storm before it ends you.
en-SG.Win the salvo duel with at most 52 shots: Win the salvo duel with at most 52 shots
en-SG.Six mines guard the approach and every o: Six mines guard the approach and every one of them bills you a shell for the lesson. Thread the field and sink what hides behind it.
en-SG.Win with at most 44 shots across a six-m: Win with at most 44 shots across a six-mine field
en-SG.Parade rules at war footing: no two ship: Parade rules at war footing: no two ships may touch, and the allowance leaves no room for awkward formations.
en-SG.Win with strict spacing and at most 56 s: Win with strict spacing and at most 56 shots
en-SG.Total signal fog against a veteran comma: Total signal fog against a veteran commander. No names, no confirmations — only the tally you keep yourself.
en-SG.Win under fog with at most 44 shots: Win under fog with at most 44 shots
en-SG.Six by six of brackish water, three litt: Six by six of brackish water, three little ships apiece, and eighteen rounds to settle it. Every shot is a declaration.
en-SG.The gunnery school wants proof, not vict: The gunnery school wants proof, not victory laps. Sink the squadron while landing more hits than misses.
en-SG.The relay buoy dies in four minutes. Bre: The relay buoy dies in four minutes. Break the squadron before the light does — hesitation is the only true enemy here.
en-SG.Every engagement opens with a secret dep: Every engagement opens with a secret deployment. Place all three ships on your chart. Ships cannot overlap or hang off the edge.
en-SG.Select a ship from the tray, then tap a: Select a ship from the tray, then tap a cell to place its bow. Use Rotate (or R) to change direction. Repeat until every ship is deployed, then press Confirm Deployment.
en-SG.The instructor has deployed. Pick any co: The instructor has deployed. Pick any coordinate on the target chart and fire.
en-SG.Tap a coordinate on the large target cha: Tap a coordinate on the large target chart to select it, then tap again or press Fire (Enter). Watch the result marker.
en-SG.A white ring means open water. An orange: A white ring means open water. An orange spear means hull contact. Keep firing until you score a hit.
en-SG.Fire at coordinates until you land a HIT: Fire at coordinates until you land a HIT. Hits stay marked — a damaged ship still floats until every cell is struck.
en-SG.Captains annotate the chart. Flag a cell: Captains annotate the chart. Flag a cell you suspect holds a ship, or mark one as unknown. Notes are private and never end your turn.
en-SG.Toggle Note mode (N), then tap any cell: Toggle Note mode (N), then tap any cell to flag it. Toggle again to switch between flag and question marks; tap a marked cell to clear it.
en-SG.Sink the entire instructor fleet before: Sink the entire instructor fleet before yours falls. Hints are enabled if you want a suggestion.
en-SG.Use hit markers to trace each ship and s: Use hit markers to trace each ship and sink all three. Good hunting, Captain.
Win a match with at least 60% accuracy.
Win the daily challenge 3 days running.
Earn 3 stars on any 8 mastery stages.
en-SG.A cipher came through at midnight: hosti: A cipher came through at midnight: hostile hulls in the patrol box, composition unknown until your first hit. Routine, if routine ever were.
en-SG.Today’s water, today’s war. The signal c: Today’s water, today’s war. The signal corps drew this box from the lottery drum — make it read like a lesson.
en-SG.No name for this engagement yet, Captain: No name for this engagement yet, Captain. Win it well and the logkeeper will invent something heroic.
en-SG.The fleet rotates its watch, but the sea: The fleet rotates its watch, but the sea keeps its own schedule. Clear today’s box before the tide of shells runs out.
en-SG.hostedTableIntro: Two to four captains share this table. The chart is hidden between turns — hand the device over when prompted. Placement and shots are validated by the same authoritative script that runs online sessions (server.js); reconnecting mid-match restores the last snapshot from the title screen.

en-HK.A vanguard squadron under full fog and s: A vanguard squadron under full fog and salvo fire, fifty-five rounds to finish it. They will not announce their dead. Neither will you.
en-HK.Mastery board. Salvos over mined water a: Mastery board. Salvos over mined water against the fleet’s best opposing mind. The protocol is iron, Captain — be iron with it.
en-HK.The gauntlet begins. Thirty-eight rounds: The gauntlet begins. Thirty-eight rounds, two mines, silent sinkings, and a full squadron that knows your trade. No margin was ever promised.
en-HK.Wide spacing, salvo fire, fifty shots on: Wide spacing, salvo fire, fifty shots on the big ocean. Discipline is the only supply ship still sailing with you, Captain.
en-HK.Twin cruisers, three mines, fifty-two ro: Twin cruisers, three mines, fifty-two rounds of thunder. Strike the hammer blow and do not waste the echo.
en-HK.Four mines and total silence. The toll i: Four mines and total silence. The toll is paid in shells and certainty, and you are short of both. One stage remains after this.
en-HK.The capstone, Captain: a vanguard squadr: The capstone, Captain: a vanguard squadron under fog and mines, salvo against salvo, fifty-five rounds in the locker. Win, and the fleet speaks your name in every port.
en-HK.The convoy sails at dusk and the magazin: The convoy sails at dusk and the magazine is nearly bare. Sink the squadron on the tightest allowance the quartermaster has ever signed.
en-HK.Salvo doctrine without restraint: every: Salvo doctrine without restraint: every hull afloat fires every turn, theirs included. End the storm before it ends you.
en-HK.Win the salvo duel with at most 52 shots: Win the salvo duel with at most 52 shots
en-HK.Six mines guard the approach and every o: Six mines guard the approach and every one of them bills you a shell for the lesson. Thread the field and sink what hides behind it.
en-HK.Win with at most 44 shots across a six-m: Win with at most 44 shots across a six-mine field
en-HK.Parade rules at war footing: no two ship: Parade rules at war footing: no two ships may touch, and the allowance leaves no room for awkward formations.
en-HK.Win with strict spacing and at most 56 s: Win with strict spacing and at most 56 shots
en-HK.Total signal fog against a veteran comma: Total signal fog against a veteran commander. No names, no confirmations — only the tally you keep yourself.
en-HK.Win under fog with at most 44 shots: Win under fog with at most 44 shots
en-HK.Six by six of brackish water, three litt: Six by six of brackish water, three little ships apiece, and eighteen rounds to settle it. Every shot is a declaration.
en-HK.The gunnery school wants proof, not vict: The gunnery school wants proof, not victory laps. Sink the squadron while landing more hits than misses.
en-HK.The relay buoy dies in four minutes. Bre: The relay buoy dies in four minutes. Break the squadron before the light does — hesitation is the only true enemy here.
en-HK.Every engagement opens with a secret dep: Every engagement opens with a secret deployment. Place all three ships on your chart. Ships cannot overlap or hang off the edge.
en-HK.Select a ship from the tray, then tap a: Select a ship from the tray, then tap a cell to place its bow. Use Rotate (or R) to change direction. Repeat until every ship is deployed, then press Confirm Deployment.
en-HK.The instructor has deployed. Pick any co: The instructor has deployed. Pick any coordinate on the target chart and fire.
en-HK.Tap a coordinate on the large target cha: Tap a coordinate on the large target chart to select it, then tap again or press Fire (Enter). Watch the result marker.
en-HK.A white ring means open water. An orange: A white ring means open water. An orange spear means hull contact. Keep firing until you score a hit.
en-HK.Fire at coordinates until you land a HIT: Fire at coordinates until you land a HIT. Hits stay marked — a damaged ship still floats until every cell is struck.
en-HK.Captains annotate the chart. Flag a cell: Captains annotate the chart. Flag a cell you suspect holds a ship, or mark one as unknown. Notes are private and never end your turn.
en-HK.Toggle Note mode (N), then tap any cell: Toggle Note mode (N), then tap any cell to flag it. Toggle again to switch between flag and question marks; tap a marked cell to clear it.
en-HK.Sink the entire instructor fleet before: Sink the entire instructor fleet before yours falls. Hints are enabled if you want a suggestion.
en-HK.Use hit markers to trace each ship and s: Use hit markers to trace each ship and sink all three. Good hunting, Captain.

en-BQ.Dawn watch, Captain. Three hostile hulls: Dawn watch, Captain. Three hostile hulls hide in a six-by-six sounding — small water, small fleet, no excuses. Find them and put them under.
en-BQ.The gunnery crews are green, so the flee: The gunnery crews are green, so the fleet kindly anchored more targets in the sound. Same drill as yesterday — steadier hands this time.
en-BQ.A fourth ship has joined the enemy floti: A fourth ship has joined the enemy flotilla — a cruiser, longer and harder to miss once you clip her. Work the grid methodically, Captain.
en-BQ.The admiral has authorised pencil correc: The admiral has authorised pencil corrections on this exercise: take back a placement or a shot while you still learn the chart. Training wheels, nothing more.
en-BQ.Mastery board, Captain: the same cramped: Mastery board, Captain: the same cramped water, but the opposing commander finally woke up. Clear the channel cleanly and the fleet sails at your word.
en-BQ.The training pool is behind you. Eight b: The training pool is behind you. Eight by eight of open sea and a full five-ship squadron — carrier and all — waiting beyond the mist.
en-BQ.New doctrine from the quartermaster: eve: New doctrine from the quartermaster: every shell is counted. You have a generous allowance for this patrol — spend it, but learn to spend it well.
en-BQ.The magazines run thinner today. Fifty r: The magazines run thinner today. Fifty rounds for the whole engagement — a careful captain will not need the last ten.
en-BQ.Forty-five shells and an enemy who has s: Forty-five shells and an enemy who has started reading your patterns. Hunt in straight lines, close on your hits, and the margin holds.
en-BQ.Mastery board. The audit is simple, Capt: Mastery board. The audit is simple, Captain: sink the squadron inside forty-two rounds, or explain the shortfall to the fleet in person.
en-BQ.Charts show a single loose mine adrift i: Charts show a single loose mine adrift in the patrol box. Striking it costs you an extra round and gains nothing — shoot around it, Captain.
en-BQ.Two mines now, sown where the water runs: Two mines now, sown where the water runs shallow. The enemy hides among them and trusts you to be careless. Prove the trust misplaced.
en-BQ.Now the two lessons meet: mines under th: Now the two lessons meet: mines under the water, a ledger over your head. Fifty rounds, two hazards, one squadron to erase.
en-BQ.Three mines and forty-eight shells. Ever: Three mines and forty-eight shells. Every stray shot is a double loss now — the round, and the allowance it came from.
en-BQ.Mastery board. The channel is sown thick: Mastery board. The channel is sown thick and the magazine is thin. Bring the fleet through, Captain, and no mine will ever frighten you again.
en-BQ.Salvo doctrine, Captain: every ship stil: Salvo doctrine, Captain: every ship still afloat fires each turn. Your broadsides grow weaker as hulls die — so will theirs. Trade well.
en-BQ.Two squadrons in line ahead, guns speaki: Two squadrons in line ahead, guns speaking in volleys. Kill their small ships early and starve their salvo before yours thins.
en-BQ.Salvos feel generous until the ledger ar: Salvos feel generous until the ledger arrives. Forty-eight total shots across every volley — make the early ones count.
en-BQ.Full broadsides over mined water. A salv: Full broadsides over mined water. A salvo that finds a mine pays double — watch where the volley falls.
en-BQ.Mastery board. Salvos, mines, and a fort: Mastery board. Salvos, mines, and a forty-four shot ceiling, all at once. Conduct it cleanly, Captain, and the watch will remember.
en-BQ.New standing order: no two ships may moo: New standing order: no two ships may moor hull-to-hull, not even corner to corner — collisions kill more fleets than guns do. Plot a spread formation.
en-BQ.The enemy has jammed our signal lamps: s: The enemy has jammed our signal lamps: sinkings are confirmed, but no longer named. Count hulls in your head, Captain, because the chart will not.
en-BQ.Ten by ten now — real ocean. The enemy f: Ten by ten now — real ocean. The enemy fields a vanguard squadron: a carrier, twin cruisers, escorts. More water to search, more steel to sink.
en-BQ.Wide-berth discipline under signal fog,: Wide-berth discipline under signal fog, on the big water. You will not know what you have sunk — only that something stopped answering.
en-BQ.Mastery board. A convoy you cannot name,: Mastery board. A convoy you cannot name, a sixty-shell allowance you cannot stretch. Trust the hunt, Captain — the ghosts will not trust you.
en-BQ.Mines below, silence above. Two hazards: Mines below, silence above. Two hazards you must feel for and a foe whose losses you must tally yourself.
en-BQ.Salvo discipline with parade-ground spac: Salvo discipline with parade-ground spacing — your ships may not touch, and every survivor fires. Elegant on paper, murder on water.
Big ocean, two mines, fifty-five rounds. The ledger looks generous until the tenth empty volley — guard it, Captain.
